Umm Šarīf prefer old-fashioned movies; Yāsmīn She thinks the new series are closer to today's life, and her mother responds that they are all cell phones and screams. Luca says he agrees with both about something: the old movie was beautiful and the songs gorgeous, but the series seen with Šarīf taught him the words of the young men; for this Umm Šarīf He calls it "diplomatic" like the Egyptians.
